d: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has unveiled at least a dozen nuclear warheads. The images released by North Korean state media show the leader inspecting a secrety military facility that is used for producing and storing nuclear material. Analysis by North Korea's nuclear programme watcher, Nukesletter, several of the warheads have been identified. This includes the Hwasan-31, The Peanut, The Olive and the Disco Ball.
